preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 and 1 <= M <= 10**5 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N and M are between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= N and 0 <= y <= N for N, M, edges in test_cases for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge in each test case, the vertices x and y are between 0 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(sequence, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) and x > 0 for x in sequence) for sequence in sequences) or all(sequence == -1 for sequence in sequences)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either a list of positive integers or -1 if no valid sequence exists.

postconditions.expression: all(len(sequence) == N for sequence, N in zip(sequences, N_values) if sequence != -1)
postconditions.description: If a valid sequence exists for a test case, its length is equal to N.
